name: seabed_v000
_doc: PRE-CALIBRATION erodible-seabed demo — the FULL live morphodynamic loop (fluid -> bed-shear wall model tau_b -> suspended sediment -> bed Exner update -> avalanche) coupled to the live flow, with the voxelized V000 structure seated in a 1 m sand bed. This is a QUALITATIVE visualisation so the user can watch a scour hole develop; it is NOT a measurement and NOT calibrated. The van Rijn pickup alpha, Smagorinsky Cs, MORFAC and d50 below are NOMINAL/uncalibrated placeholders — alpha/Cs/HSV calibration is the SUPERVISED M6 milestone (Roulund pile-scour), which must pass before any shape ranking is trustworthy. Run: build/Release/scour-gui.exe --scenario configs/seabed_v000.json (or pass the file positionally). If the structure STEP is absent, the demo falls back to a bare erodible seabed.
